title: Alternative Protein Food Products: Mexico deep edition

questions.q: In "Read your local market Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Start with one product and one meal moment, for example a plant-based snack for lunch. Test taste with a small group.
Cluster A, Online selling and marketing: Strong fit: messaging-app selling and marketplaces. Offer cash-payment and bank-transfer options.
Keep batch records: ingredient source, date, batch number and storage temperature, so a recall can trace it.
Compare three models: make your own, use a contract food maker, or sell a recipe to a producer. Judge by cost and control.

questions.q: In "Choose your sector Analyse", which of these is a key idea?
o: Keep batch records: ingredient source, date, batch number and storage temperature, so a recall can trace it.
Keep marketing consent records; offer a clear way to stop messages.
Cluster B, Technology and digital services: Strong fit: near-shoring means firms need IT support, testing, security and cloud services in Spanish.
Write MXN next to every number.

questions.q: In "Register and license Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Employers register staff for social security and pay the year-end bonus; budget both.
Some activities need extra licences (food, health, tourism, money); list yours before the first order. Check with a local expert.
Channels: messaging apps, social media and marketplaces; local fairs and markets for a first test.
Launch with a go or no-go rule: a passed safety review, a shelf life of 21 days, and 200 packs sold in 4 weeks. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Protect data and customers Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Written contracts and signed copies for every helper, even part-time.
Keep batch records: ingredient source, date, batch number and storage temperature, so a recall can trace it.
Prove demand and quality with a tasting event and a pre-order list; record the counts honestly.
List partners: a licensed food maker, an ingredient supplier, a lab for shelf-life tests and a shop buyer.

questions.q: In "Find and serve customers Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Dates: first test, first order, first review.
Cluster F, Food and farming: Strong fit: food and farming are central; check health-risk rules for food and alternative proteins. Check with a local expert.
Launch with a go or no-go rule: a passed safety review, a shelf life of 21 days, and 200 packs sold in 4 weeks. Check with a local expert.
Language: Spanish first, in plain words; add English only if customers ask.

questions.q: In "Price, tax and money Evaluate", which of these is a key idea?
o: A large market with strong regional differences. Start in one city and one niche.
Written contracts and signed copies for every helper, even part-time.
Calculate cost per pack: ingredients, packing, making, cold chain and margin.
Cluster F, Food and farming: Strong fit: food and farming are central; check health-risk rules for food and alternative proteins. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "People and partners Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Payments: bank transfer, cards and cash-payment points; show prices with the sales tax clearly. Check with a local expert.
Written contracts and signed copies for every helper, even part-time.
Add tax and duty explicitly; never bury them in a price. Check with a local expert.
Electronic invoices are part of daily trade: learn them in week one.

Check against a worse case: if sales are 25% lower, do you still cover costs?
